issues.water-now-twice: On /beds, double-clicking or rapidly re-clicking 'Water now' sends multiple POST /api/waterings requests and records duplicate waterings because the button is not disabled while saving.
issues.negative-litres: The /beds past-watering form and POST /api/waterings accept negative (or otherwise non-positive) litres such as -5 and list them as negative amounts.
issues.oversized-integer-id-500: Sending a bed_id or watering id above 64 bits (e.g. 99999999999999999999) to POST/GET/DELETE /api/waterings returns a 500 Internal Server Error instead of a 4xx.
issues.non-finite-litres-500: POST /api/waterings with a non-finite litres value such as 1e400 (infinity) or NaN returns a 500 Internal Server Error instead of a 422.
issues.boolean-litres-accepted: POST /api/waterings with litres set to boolean true is accepted with 201 and stored as 1.0 litres.
issues.tiny-litres-shown-as-zero: Recording a past watering with a tiny positive amount (e.g. 0.001 L) is accepted despite the 0.1 field minimum and is displayed as '0 L' in the notice, dashboard and waterings list.
issues.ancient-date-accepted: A past watering dated far in the past (e.g. 0001-01-01) is accepted by the form and POST /api/waterings and listed as '1 Jan 1'.
issues.server-vs-client-date-timezone: When the browser's time zone is ahead of the server's, a past watering dated with the form's default 'today' is refused as in the future, and 'Water now' stores a server-local date with a UTC time.
issues.ssr-timestamp-timezone-hydration: Watering timestamps are formatted without a fixed time zone, so viewing the pages from a time zone different from the Nuxt server's causes SSR/client mismatches.
issues.watering-post-no-idempotency: Retrying 'Water now' or 'Save watering' after a lost or timed-out response creates a duplicate watering because POST /api/waterings has no idempotency key or dedupe.
issues.shared-watering-busy-state: On /beds, clicking 'Water now' on a second bed while the first request is pending uses one shared busy flag and message, re-enabling a pending bed's button (allowing duplicates) and overwriting the other bed's notice.
issues.watering-saved-but-refresh-failure-repor: On /beds, when POST /api/waterings succeeds but the follow-up GET /api/beds refresh fails, the save is reported as failed or the bed list is replaced by 'Could not load beds.', inviting a duplicate retry.
issues.requests-no-timeout: Watering requests (Water now, Save watering, waterings list, delete, dashboard) have no 10 s timeout, so a hanging API leaves 'Watering…'/'Saving…'/'Loading waterings…' on screen indefinitely.
issues.waterings-navigation-blocked-while-loadi: Clicking the Waterings nav link while GET /api/waterings hangs leaves the previous page on screen indefinitely with no loading indication.
issues.dashboard-waterings-no-loading-state: The dashboard 'Recent waterings' section shows only its heading with no loading indicator while GET /api/waterings is pending.
issues.waterings-load-error-no-retry: When GET /api/waterings fails, the /waterings page and the dashboard 'Recent waterings' section show only an error message with no Retry control, so recovery requires a reload.
issues.waterings-beds-error-silent: On /waterings, a failing GET /api/beds is ignored and the bed filter silently offers only 'All beds' with no error or retry.
issues.invalid-bed-query-raw-error: Opening /waterings?bed=abc (or an unknown bed id) shows the raw validation text 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer...' or a blank filter selection.
issues.bed-filter-not-synced-with-url: On /waterings, the bed filter is read from the URL only at setup, so navigating to /waterings or using back/forward keeps the old filter while the URL changes.
issues.stale-filter-results: On /waterings, rapidly changing or failing bed-filter refetches can leave a previous bed's rows displayed under the new filter or alongside the error.
issues.delete-already-deleted-shows-error: Deleting a watering that was already deleted (second tab or retry) on /waterings shows a 404 'Watering not found.' error and leaves the stale row.
issues.long-bed-name-overflow-375: A bed with a long unbroken name makes the waterings tables on /waterings and the dashboard overflow horizontally at 375 px width.
issues.huge-litres-breaks-layout: A stored extreme litres value such as -1e308 renders as a 300+ digit amount on /waterings and the dashboard, forcing horizontal scrolling at 375 px.
issues.water-now-check-fails-after-reload: After a reload of / or /waterings, the app check app-water-now-records-once fails, reporting zero POST /api/waterings sent where one was expected.
issues.auth-me-error-no-retry: On /login, when GET /api/auth/me fails (500, 400, reset, 429), there is no way to retry without a page reload.
issues.login-error-no-retry: On /login, after POST /api/auth/login fails (500, reset, 400, 429), a retry does not reach the Dashboard within 10 s.
issues.dashboard-summary-error-no-retry: On /, when GET /api/dashboard/summary fails (500, 400, reset, 429), there is no way to retry without a page reload.
issues.tasks-upcoming-error-no-retry: On /, when GET /api/tasks/upcoming fails (500, 400, reset, 429), there is no way to retry without a page reload.
issues.beds-load-failure-clears-typed-values: On /beds, when GET /api/beds fails, the text typed into the Add bed 'Name' field is cleared and the retry does not recover.
issues.add-bed-stuck-after-malformed-beds: On /beds, when GET /api/beds returns malformed JSON, a render error is thrown and the 'Add bed' button stays disabled on 'Adding…'.
issues.dashboard-nan-after-malformed-tasks: On /, when GET /api/tasks/upcoming returns malformed JSON, the page shows the text 'NaN'.
issues.dashboard-undefined-after-malformed-summ: On /, when GET /api/dashboard/summary returns malformed JSON, the page shows the text 'undefined'.
issues.waterings-uncaught-error-malformed-json: On /waterings, when GET /api/waterings returns malformed JSON, an unhandled render error or dev error overlay appears.
issues.waterings-uncaught-error-beds-malformed: On /waterings, when GET /api/beds returns malformed JSON or 500, an unhandled render error and dev error overlay appear.
issues.waterings-uncaught-error-bad-bed-input: On /waterings, entering bad values into the 'Bed' filter select triggers the dev error overlay.
issues.waterings-uncaught-error-signed-out-relo: Reloading /waterings while signed out triggers the dev error overlay.
issues.beds-uncaught-error-after-beds-load-fail: On /beds, when GET /api/beds returns malformed JSON or hangs, an unhandled render error and dev error overlay appear.
issues.beds-uncaught-error-watering-post-timeou: On /beds, when POST /api/waterings hangs, the dev error overlay appears.
issues.beds-uncaught-error-bed-post-timeout: On /beds, when POST /api/beds hangs, the dev error overlay appears.
issues.beds-uncaught-error-bad-litres-input: On /beds, entering a negative value into the 'Litres' field triggers the dev error overlay.
issues.beds-uncaught-error-on-navigation: Reloading /beds or navigating back and forward to /beds triggers the dev error overlay.
issues.dashboard-uncaught-error-tasks-429: On /, when GET /api/tasks/upcoming is rate limited with 429, the dev error overlay appears.
